visualCharacteristics.purpose: standalone Lottie animation (e.g. animated card strip or scrolling ribbon) lazily rendered from a Lottie JSON file

contentPattern.structure: one cell: link to the Lottie .json file (link text or title = accessible label); optional fallback picture shown until/if the animation fails to load

reuseGuidance: Use for decorative or illustrative Lottie animations. The loader lives in /scripts/lottie.js (shared with hero-split). Does not autoplay with prefers-reduced-motion; a play/pause toggle is rendered.
